notes.title: Update 1.3.3
notes.content:
This update addresses several community-reported bugs and includes a few quality-of-life improvements:
[list]
[*] Pong Train Fix: The floppy disk for Pong Train will now correctly appear if the player has unlocked Flappy Train but hasn't yet collected the floppy.
[*] Fixed various minor issues in the Chapter Selection menu and Community Level preview frames.
[*] Progress Reset Update: The "Erase All Tracks" button in the Settings menu has been updated to "Reset Progress". This will now fully reset progress across all chapters, allowing players to replay the game from the beginning.
[/list]
Thank you all for your continued support, feedback, and for playing the game.
Have a wonderful summer!

notes.title: Update 1.3.2
notes.content: This is a small hotfix update solving some issues with the hints on some specific levels.

notes.title: Version 1.3.1
notes.content:
Hello train conductors, we have a small hotfix update that addresses the following issues:

[list]
[*] Resource Wagon issues on the Attic and Community levels are now fixed.
[*] Added hints to levels that were missing those.
[*] Slight rework on the level design of some levels (Chapter 4 Level 19,  Chapter 6 Level 24)
[*] Fixed an issue where the wrong tab would be selected after exiting an Attic Level
[/list]

notes.title: New stuff in Trains!! 🚂
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971122/1fb29e3fefc0f13db8e6ccf4a046981df9906538.png[/img]

A brand-new update has arrived, bringing fresh challenges, new mechanics, and exciting additions to your railway adventure!
[h3]
What's new;[/h3]
[b][list]
[*] New Bonus Chapter! Explore 30 new levels plus 5 Master Tracks.
[*] A New Train! Expand your collection with a brand-new locomotive.
[*] Traffic Lights! This new mechanic lets you control train movement—red means stop, green means go, adding a new layer of strategy.
[*] Wagons! Every train now has its own matching wagons.
[*] New Achievement!
[*] Bug Fixes & Improvements to keep everything running smoothly.
[/list][/b]
Available now across Steam, iOS & Android!! 

P.S. It’s almost Teeny Tiny Trains’ first birthday—what a journey it’s been! 🚂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971122/78dad6bb03f64bb769904e014965a0583f9a48e0.png[/img]

notes.title: Hint System & Valentine’s Patch! 💘
notes.content:
The Hint System is here, as well as lots of exciting new features!

Check out the details of the update below;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971122/a600b2de5c71b0f0f79836162c3975f388c90735.jpg[/img]

[b]🎉 New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Hint System: Now includes every level in the game, including mastery levels.
[*]Color Picker: Improved colorblind accessibility and added customization options. You can now choose your four train colors from a large selection!
[*]Valentine’s Train Quest: A special Valentine’s-themed quest! Look out for a train pop-up after meeting the quest objective. ❤️🚂 [b](Available from February 3rd!)[/b]
[*]Community Maps: 10x10 community maps are now available for more puzzle-solving fun!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971122/f360218f0cd9859c7db40a19d1fd5849305970d6.jpg[/img]

[b]🔧 Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Handbook Rework: We’ve revamped the Handbook, now with added Attic DLC mechanics.
[*]Track Management: You can now delete or clear all tracks for all levels directly from the settings menu.
[*]Placement Mode Tweaks: We’ve made several improvements to make track placement smoother.
[*]Tunnels Improvement: Entrances and exits for tunnels are now clearly highlighted.
[*]Crash Clarity: We’ve improved the messaging to give you more info when crashes occur.
[*]Community Maps Filters: You can now filter maps by the most played. Steam now also supports copying a map’s ID directly.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971122/ced298435609b8da0bea31205cf39b376b65200b.jpg[/img]

[b]🐞 Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed station spawn issue.
[*]Resolved a color scale ID issue.
[*]Resolved the ticket bug in Chapter 7, Level 10.
[/list]
[b]💡 Still Working On:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixing the train speed issue.   
[/list]
Let us know what you think of the update 🚂

💌 Short Circuit Studio

notes.title: Holiday Update + We are Steam deck Verified! ✔️🎄
notes.content:
It's the most wonderful time of the year - [b]Teeny Tiny Trains Holiday update time! [/b]🎄

[b]New Things:[/b]

- Steam Deck Verified: We are now fully Steam Deck Verified! Enjoy smooth gameplay wherever you go.
- Gingerbread Train: Celebrate the holiday season with the Gingerbread Train! Instantly unlock this festive train by opening the game. Available to claim until the end of January.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

- Adjusted the "Web of Shadows" achievement to work as intended.
- Fixed an issue where certain sound effects were playing repetitively.

[b]Available across both PC & Mobile![/b]

As the year comes to a close, we want to extend our heartfelt thanks to all of you for your incredible support. Your feedback and enthusiasm make Teeny Tiny Trains what it is today. 
We’re excited to continue updating the game in the new year with even more surprises! 🚂💟

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971122/b671407724b49d9ce0fd14f5a7269da4632ee828.png[/img]

notes.title: Retro Arcade Classics Meet Teeny Tiny Trains!
notes.content:
[h2]The latest "Retro Arcade on Rails" patch for Teeny Tiny Trains! [/h2]

We are doubling down on the Nostalgic vibes! This update brings exciting enhancements & new features to the game and quality of life improvements;

[list]
[*] Speed Slider now ranges from 0-10 (So you can finally pause! )
[*] Fixed top-down camera view issues.
[*] Updated community section with more map details.
[*] Launched Traincade with unlockable minigames.
[*] New unlockable trains via Traincade.
[*] Improved train collision handling.
[*] New achievements.
[*] Resolved an issue with achievements not registering.
[*] Placement/Drawing mode now toggleable on the main screen.
[*] Game will now continue to run even if you're tabbed out!
[/list]

This is our first major update since launching and we really appreciate all the feedback from players that helped us shape it ːluvː 

Please keep sharing what you'd like to see next!
